text: The Esports World Cup Foundation describes itself as a non-profit not owned by the Saudi state but funded through a sports grant from the Public Investment Fund; the Saudi cabinet named Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman chair of its board of trustees on 2 Sep 2025.

source.name: The Esports Advocate
source.note: Cites Saudi state media on the cabinet decision; also notes MBS chairs the board of PIF-owned Savvy Games Group.
